contentItem.title: 性质与证明：连比例与比例与整数
contentItem.englishTitle: If there be as many numbers as we please in continued proportion, and each by multiplying itself make some number, the products will be proportional; and, if the original numbers by multiplying the products make certain numbers, the latter will also be proportional.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: If there be as many numbers as we please in continued proportion, and each by multiplying itself make some number, the products will be proportional; and, if the original numbers by multiplying the products make certain numbers, the latter will also be proportional.
如果连比例我们想多算多少,而每个乘以自己就得出一些数字,那么产品将是成比例;如果最初的数字是乘以产品就得出一定数字,那么,后者也是成比例。

Let there be as many numbers as we please, A, B, C, in continued proportion, so that, as A is to B, so is B to C; let A, B, C by multiplying themselves make D, E, F, and by multiplying D, E, F let them make G, H, K; I say that D, E, F and G, H, K are in continued proportion.
A,B,C,连比例,A,B,A,B,B,B,B,B,A,A,A,A,A,E,F乘以D,E,F乘以D,G,H,K;我说,D,E,F和G,H,K乘以连比例；A 与 B 之比等于 B 与 C 之比。
For let A by multiplying B make L, and let the numbers A, B by multiplying L make M. N respectively.
A和B的产物是L,A和B的乘以L,分别是M和N。
And again let B by multiplying C make O, and let the numbers B, C by multiplying O make P, Q respectively.
让B和C的作品 成为O让数字B,C乘以O 分别是P,Q

Then, in manner similar to the foregoing, we can prove that D, L, E and G, M, N, H are continuously proportional in the ratio of A to B, and further E, O, F and H, P, Q, K are continuously proportional in the ratio of B to C.
然后,我们以类似上述方式,可以证明D、L、E和G、M、N、H继续为成比例,比例为A至B,还有E、O、F和H,P、Q、K继续为成比例,比例为B至C。
Now, as A is to B, so is B to C; therefore D, L, E are also in the same ratio with E, O, F, and further G, M, N, H in the same ratio with H, P, Q, K.
现在,A对B对C的比等于D对E,L对E的比,O对F,F,G对N对H,H对H,P、Q、K；A 与 B 之比等于 B 与 C 之比。（相关点与线段：M）

And the multitude of D, L, E is equal to the multitude of E, O, F, and that of G, M, N, H to that of H, P, Q, K; therefore, ex acquali, as D is to E, so is E to F, and, as G is to H, so is H to K. [[VII. 14](/principles/euclid-7-14)] Q. E. D.
D,L,E等同E,O,F,G,M,N,H与H,P,Q,K;因此,在阿夸里,D-E的比等于E-F,G与H的比等于H与K,Q；D 与 E 之比等于 E 与 F 之比；G 与 H 之比等于 H 与 K 之比。 [[VII. 14](/principles/euclid-7-14)]
